notes.title: New Psychological Horror Game: METAHORROR THERAPY SESSION
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156039/08267b1846fe00aca4db87161cb9052b457476b4.png

Dr. Montgomery's latest patient, Noel, is as mysterious as he is prone to obfuscating. 

But there's something odd about these sessions with him. Something left unsaid.

It's almost as if... they cannot escape this room.


| A visual novel about an endless therapy session - developed, directed, produced and written by a psychologist! ||

COMING TO STEAM IN JUNE 2025!

WISHLIST NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3560830/Metahorror_Therapy_Session/

If you enjoyed MyGF, you're going to love this next release! I've been working very hard on it for nearly 2 years, so please wishlist it to help out!

- Meiri

notes.title: HYDRANGEA - Yandere horror game is out on Steam!
notes.content:
Hydrangea, my new Yandere psychological horror visual novel, is now out on Steam for FREE!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3121650

Features:

- Choose your name, as well as your sweetheart's name, pronouns, and appearence.

- Contains four endings. Aim to see the first three to unlock the true end.

- Original soundtrack, backgrounds, portraits, and CGs!

- Story length: 20k words.

Languages: Brazilian Portuguese, English, French

Play it, leave a review, recommend it to your friends - my reach may be small, but my passion for creating story-rich games is big.


--------------------------------------------------------------------

notes.title: MyGF: Another Episode to be released on December 19th!
notes.content:
Another Episode will be released on Steam on December 19th! Same price as on the original itch.io release, - $3.99. You will be able to grab it with a 10% discount on release day!

Another Episode has been out on itch.io since February, and I'm super excited to share it on Steam as well.

Check out the store page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2449910/MyGF_Another/

🤍A brand new game in the world of 'My GF Doesn't Know What I'm Into!' Discover new sides to the cast and enjoy the story from different perspectives.🤍  


 Includes three Episodes*: 'Episode Amy', 'Episode Mafuyu', and 'Happier Days', featuring hours of content, new CGs, backgrounds, portraits, music, and some secrets to uncover!
 Your choices matter: follow the different routes and possibilities that unlock based on your decisions.
 Aim to see all endings to unlock the True End and new episodes.


Unlike the itch,io release, Another Episode will be playable here on Steam as add-on DLC, meaning that you'll play it from the base game, rather than having to launch a different .exe. Merging two games into one was a painful and long process, which is why it took a while for this announcement to happen!

I also had to consider other little details such as: Another Episode is only available in English and Portuguese, what happens if the player set their language to something else? I had to consider that, and create a screen that forces the language to be changed to a compatible one.

Moreover, Another Episode allows freely saving and loading. I had to patch the original game to check if the DLC is on, if it's been played, if it's not - all to make sure that the feature is only available for the DLC and not the base game.

Anyway, thankfully the struggle is over! I hope you'll enjoy the content Another Episode will offer.

Follow me on twitter for live updates: https://twitter.com/meimcmei

My instagram: https://www.instagram.com/meiri_games/

notes.title: December 12th: Steam Feedback Update
notes.content:
This update focuses on the feedback giving by players on Steam. To be more precise, it shortens the time of pauses and transitions.

E.g

    Dissolves that were 3 seconds are now 2 seconds
    Pauses that were 1.5 seconds are now 1 second

All pauses and transitions were shortened. No transitions or pauses are more than 4 seconds. Some pauses were deleted altogether.

WHY IS THE DOWNLOAD SIZE BIGGER?

Another Episode, MyGF's paid DLC, will be available as add-on DLC here on Steam, unlike on itch.io, where it’s a standalone game. This was a long, painful process, held together by prayers and re-doing old code.
To make this less painless, some of the AE art assets are be in the base game, which is why the download is bigger.

To keep it short, the game will recognize if the DLC ‘patch’ file has been purchased, and unlock the new content from the ‘extras’ menu, where Another Episode can be played straight from the base .exe.

I don’t know when AE will be out here; I’m currently rewriting most of it to reflect the quality I wish it to have as a paid product. This means I’ll also have to redo the Portuguese translation from scratch, which means even more work.

I don’t want to rush the process. AE will be on Steam in its best possible state, bug-free.

Thank you for your support.
